title: Group Anagrams
description: Sort each word into a key. Words with the same key go into the same list.
note: map(list) creates a fresh list for each missing key. word.sorted() returns a new string.
notes: map(list) creates a fresh list when a key is first looked up. Pushing a word adds it to that stored list; later lookups reuse it. Python expresses the same approach with defaultdict(list).
word.sorted() returns a new string ordered by Unicode scalar value, leaving the original string unchanged. String equality and hashing use the scalar sequence as stored.
groups.values() returns a new outer list whose nested lists remain shared with the map. The order of the groups is unspecified while map iteration order is still undecided.
